title: Choose how many players sit at the table
description:
As a learner, I want to choose a table of 2 to 10 players including me, so that I can practise heads-up, short-handed and full-ring play.

Game Config offers the players options 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10 (including the user), labelled 2 (heads-up), 6 (6-max) and 10 (full ring) as in the Config storyboard. Mapping to reference sizes: 2 -> heads-up; 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 -> 6-max; 8, 9, 10 -> full ring. Sizes 2, 6, 9, 10 are exact; for 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8 the screen states that advice will be approximate and names the reference size used. Start game seats the user plus (size - 1) bots; heads-up rules come from E01-S09, the heads-up and full-ring charts from E07-S05.

## Requirements covered
- REQ-005 (Must): Choose game type and table size — The Game Config screen shall let the user choose the game type (Cash game or Sit-and-go) and the number of players from 2 to 10 including the user.
- REQ-015 (Must): Heads-up blinds and order — While exactly two players are dealt in, the engine shall make the button post the small blind and act first preflop and last on the flop, turn and river.

Covers: REQ-005, REQ-015

Plan key: E02-S02 · Dream: limit-holdem-trainer

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given Game Config, When the players options are listed, Then they are exactly the integers 2 to 10 [REQ-005.2]
Given Game Config, When the user selects 3, 4, 5 or 7 players, Then the screen states that advice will be approximate and names 6-max as the reference size [REQ-005.3, REQ-005.4]
Given Game Config, When the user selects 8 players, Then the screen states that advice will be approximate and names full ring as the reference size [REQ-005.3, REQ-005.4]
Given Game Config, When the user selects 2, 6, 9 or 10 players, Then no approximate-advice notice is shown [REQ-005.3, REQ-005.4]
Given each size from 2 to 10 selected, When the user chooses Start game, Then the table seats the user and exactly size minus 1 bots and the header shows that number of players [REQ-005.2]
Given 2 players selected on Game Config, When the first hand of the started session is dealt, Then the button posts the small blind and the other player the big blind [REQ-015.1]

Given the player-count selector, When the user picks a table size, Then it writes SessionConfig.players and seats, replaces the read-only 'Players at the table' row, and the heads-up and full-ring size labels are either reachable and tested or removed

Given table sizes 2-5 and 7-10, When position names are shown, Then they are confirmed against the requirements' naming (TASK-3.3 A-2 rule: Button, Small blind, Big blind, Cutoff, Hijack, Under the gun, Under the gun +1, ...) with a test per size
Given a player count other than 6 is selectable, When a hand with user decisions ends, Then gradeView works at that table size (no positionOf throw) and review tests cover 2 and 10 players
Given TABLE_SIZE_NAMES, When table sizes are offered, Then every entry is used by the size choice or removed (no unused names)

Given a 2-player table, When the seats are labelled, Then the button seat shows 'Small blind' (button) and the other seat 'Big blind', matching the engine's heads-up blinds (src/table/table-view.ts positionName)
